title: System Architecture
description: English-only request flow for the React client, Express API, and static startup catalog.
code:
Browser -> React application -> /api/startups -> English startup catalog
Browser -> /api/analyze -> server-side AI diagnostic
Browser -> /api/visits -> privacy-aware operational telemetry

title: Repository Structure
description: A compact production layout with one canonical English content source.
code:
src/
  App.tsx                    # English user interface
  startups.json              # Canonical startup catalog
  startup_research.json      # Structured Wikidata findings
  startup_wikipedia.json     # English Wikipedia findings
  translations.json          # English interface copy
server.ts                     # API and application server
scripts/                      # Research, build, and audit tools

title: Startup Data Contract
description: The normalized English record shape used by the client and server.

title: API Design
description: Small English-only endpoints for catalog delivery, diagnostics, and visit telemetry.
code:
GET  /api/health    # Service status
GET  /api/startups  # Complete English startup catalog
POST /api/analyze   # English failure diagnostic
GET  /api/visits    # Recent operational visits
POST /api/visits    # Record an operational visit

title: Data Audit Pipeline
description: Repeatable validation for required fields, unique IDs, valid scores, and honest disclosure labels.
code:
node scripts/researchStartups.cjs prepare
node scripts/researchStartups.cjs merge
node scripts/buildStartupCatalog.cjs
node scripts/auditStartups.cjs src/startups.json
